summary: Tesla filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing entry into three senior unsecured credit agreements totaling $30.0 billion: a $20.0 billion three-year delayed draw term loan maturing September 29, 2029 (Citi administrative agent); an $8.0 billion five-year revolver maturing September 29, 2031 (Wells Fargo agent; $500 million letter-of-credit sublimit; USD/GBP/EUR); and a $2.0 billion 364-day revolver (Wells Fargo agent). Undrawn term commitments step down to $10.0 billion and $5.0 billion at 12 and 15 months, terminating at 18 months. No board recommendation, premium, stake, or M&A terms are stated; this is routine financing, not a special situation.
